mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (group_session_id, script_id, dm_id, player_name, script_rating, script_comment, dm_rating, dm_comment) VALUES (#{groupSessionId}, #{scriptId}, #{dmId}, #{playerName}, #{scriptRating}, #{scriptComment}, #{dmRating}, #{dmComment})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.group_session_id, r.script_id, s.name as script_name, r.dm_id, d.name as dm_name, r.player_name, r.script_rating, r.script_comment, r.dm_rating, r.dm_comment, r.created_at FROM reviews r JOIN scripts s ON r.script_id = s.id JOIN dms d ON r.dm_id = d.id WHERE r.script_id = #{scriptId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.group_session_id, r.script_id, s.name as script_name, r.dm_id, d.name as dm_name, r.player_name, r.script_rating, r.script_comment, r.dm_rating, r.dm_comment, r.created_at FROM reviews r JOIN scripts s ON r.script_id = s.id JOIN dms d ON r.dm_id = d.id WHERE r.dm_id = #{dmId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.group_session_id, r.script_id, s.name as script_name, r.dm_id, d.name as dm_name, r.player_name, r.script_rating, r.script_comment, r.dm_rating, r.dm_comment, r.created_at FROM reviews r JOIN scripts s ON r.script_id = s.id JOIN dms d ON r.dm_id = d.id WHERE r.group_session_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.group_session_id, r.script_id, s.name as script_name, r.dm_id, d.name as dm_name, r.player_name, r.script_rating, r.script_comment, r.dm_rating, r.dm_comment, r.created_at FROM reviews r JOIN scripts s ON r.script_id = s.id JOIN dms d ON r.dm_id = d.id WHERE r.group_session_id = #{groupId} AND r.player_name = #{playerName}
SELECT ROUND(AVG(script_rating)::numeric, 1) FROM reviews WHERE script_id = #{scriptId}
SELECT ROUND(AVG(dm_rating)::numeric, 1) FROM reviews WHERE dm_id = #{dmId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE script_id = #{scriptId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE dm_id = #{dmId}
